answer_4.quote: To verify the ability of our approach to better capture salient information found in reference summaries, we perform a human evaluation study using the Atomic Content Unit (ACU) protocol introduced in . In this protocol, atomic facts are extracted from reference summaries and matched with system summaries; the average number of matched units constitutes the recall-focused ACU score, and a length normalized ACU score (nACU) is also reported.
